episodes.title: Power
episodes.summary: There is disagreement whether Toronto should continue with Edison's DC system or Nikola Tesla's AC system, differences that seemingly result in murder. While the electrocution of a young woman leads Murdoch to a war between these rival electricity suppliers, Crabtree finds himself attracted to a suspect.

episodes.title: Glass Ceiling
episodes.summary: A vicious criminal, known for his deadly use of a stiletto may have escaped from jail to revenge himself on those public servants that helped convict him.

episodes.title: The Knockdown
episodes.summary: Black professional boxer Amos Robinson is supposed to throw a fight to a local Toronto favorite but knocks him out instead and is murdered before the night is out.

episodes.title: Elementary, My Dear Murdoch
episodes.summary: Arthur Conan Doyle is visiting Toronto to give a lecture on spiritualism and offers to help Murdoch solve the murder of a member of a spiritualist society.

episodes.title: Til Death Us Do Part
episodes.summary: After the heir to a profitable business is murdered in church only minutes before his marriage of convenience, a post-mortem discloses he had recently engaged in sexual activity.

episodes.title: Let Loose the Dogs
episodes.summary: One of the conspirators running a fixed dog fighting competition is murdered and the drunkard who is the prime suspect happens to be Murdoch's estranged father.

episodes.title: Body Double
episodes.summary: When a skeletal corpse falls to the stage during a performance, Murdoch discovers not only a sinister murder plot, but Brackenreid's secret love for the theatre.

episodes.title: Still Waters
episodes.summary: The affluent and influential young man who recently replaced one of the rowers for the 1896 Olympic rowing team is found drowned in the river.

episodes.title: Belly Speaker
episodes.summary: When a drunken, philandering wastrel is found dead in his room, having had varnish forced down in his throat, his estranged disturbed ventriloquist son is found in a wardrobe.

episodes.title: Child's Play
episodes.summary: Howard Rookwood is murdered in the horse stables of his glue factory; but who would want to kill a humanitarian involved with placing troubled English youth in foster homes?

episodes.title: Bad Medicine
episodes.summary: After a physician researching brain abnormalities is murdered with a crossbow, Murdoch traces the hooded killer to the patients of his institute.

episodes.title: The Prince and the Rebel
episodes.summary: Prince Alfred, grandson of Queen Victoria, is visiting Toronto and Murdoch is assigned to protect the reckless playboy a from Fenian conspiracy.

episodes.title: The Annoying Red Planet
episodes.summary: Murdoch investigates the hanging of a farmer found in a freshly plowed field with no footprints around it. Crabtree suspects extraterrestrial involvement.

episodes.title: Mild, Mild West
episodes.summary: When the traveling Buffalo Bill Cody's Western Extravaganza settles in Toronto, murders happen. Inspector Murdoch must investigate the crimes while his boss becomes enamored with Annie Oakley.

episodes.title: Snakes and Ladders
episodes.summary: Murdoch finds himself teamed with a Scotland Yard Investigator who thinks the serial killer they're pursuing may be none other than Jack the Ripper. Murdoch invites Dr. Ogden to an up-coming ball, and to prepare for it, dancing lessons are the order of the day.

episodes.title: Dinosaur Fever
episodes.summary: A geologist turned paleontologist has found a rare femur from an Albertosaurus, but when he unveils it, a mummified body is found in the mouth of another dinosaur skeleton.

episodes.title: Houdini Whodunnit?
episodes.summary: A youthful Harry Houdini becomes the chief suspect when the bank adjoining his theater is robbed and a guard is murdered. But, he ultimately helps Murdoch find the culprit. Meanwhile, Dr. Ogden's sister comes to visit and soon becomes attracted to Murdoch.

episodes.title: The Green Muse
episodes.summary: When a very popular prostitute specializing in kinky sex is found garroted and the bordello survives an arson attempt, Murdoch looks at her clients for a suspect. Also, the romance between Inspector Murdoch and Dr. Ogden heats up.

episodes.title: Shades of Grey
episodes.summary: A young woman's body is found in a drainage ditch, clad in only a bracelet, showing signs of having undergone an abortion, and totally drained of blood.

episodes.title: Big Murderer on Campus
episodes.summary: A university professor from England is shot in the head through his window, either looking at a comet or peeping at a beautiful coed.

episodes.title: I, Murdoch
episodes.summary: A young boy witnesses what sounds like a robot and men with guns near the creek where he is fishing, but no one at the precinct quite believes him.

episodes.title: Convalescence
episodes.summary: After the owner of a French restaurant is found with his own pickled finger in his mouth, Crabtree fills in for an injured Murdoch to solve the crime.

episodes.title: Murdoch.com
episodes.summary: A mysterious on-line predator romances other telegraphers, bilks them out of money, and ultimately murders one of his dalliances.

episodes.title: Let Us Ask the Maiden
episodes.summary: When a young Jewish man dies suddenly during prayers, Dr. Ogden suspects arsenic poisoning and concludes that others may be falling victim to a poisoner.

episodes.title: Werewolves
episodes.summary: Savage murder, seemingly at the jaws of a wild beast, occurs among six men who participated in a hunting trip. This leads Murdoch into the mysterious world of North American shamanism and lycanthropy. While searching for a rational explanation, Murdoch is forced to choose between Enid and Dr. Ogden.

episodes.title: Anything You Can Do
episodes.summary: While investigating a murder, Murdoch finds himself teamed with a North-West Mounted Policeman from British Columbia whose methods and mannerisms are strikingly similar to this own -- perhaps too similar? The Mountie believes the Toronto homicide is related to a case he is investigating. Murdoch hopes to rekindle his relationship with Dr. Ogden -- but is it too late?

episodes.title: The Murdoch Identity
episodes.summary: Murdoch finds himself an amnesiac in Britain with professional killers trying to find out what he knows about a planned assassination.

episodes.title: The Great Wall
episodes.summary: Murdoch is assigned to an adjacent station house when one of their officers is found murdered in Toronto's Chinatown. His theories on the crime come under question.

episodes.title: Victor, Victorian
episodes.summary: Detective Murdoch enters the secretive world of the Freemasons when a new member is poisoned during his initiation ceremony. Things take a strange turn when Doctor Ogden reveals to Murdoch, Crabtree and Inspector Brackenreid that the young accountant really wasn't the man everyone thought.

episodes.title: Rich Boy, Poor Boy
episodes.summary: Tragedy strikes close to home when Brackenreid's son Bobby suddenly disappears while playing with a friend on a sunny afternoon in bustling Allen Gardens.

episodes.title: Me, Myself and Murdoch
episodes.summary: A clearly disturbed young woman possessed of four personalities takes an ax to her abusive father possibly because of trauma suffered seventeen years earlier.A family celebration of Alexander Reynolds' 60th birthday is dampened when he's found dead from an ax plunged into his chest. Murdoch is called in and soon discovers the victim was universally despised by his kin. Reynolds' family instantly falls under suspicion, but the field of suspects narrows considerably when daughter Charlotte Reynolds appears in a blood-soaked dress and confesses to killing her father. A clearly disturbed young woman possessed of four personalities possibly killed her abusive father due to trauma suffered seventeen years earlier.

episodes.title: This One Goes to Eleven
episodes.summary: When a famous Rembrandt nude is stolen while it is in transit on a moving elevator, Murdoch, who was present during the theft, finds himself asking how, not who.

episodes.title: Blood and Circuses
episodes.summary: When a traveling circus comes to town, a series of murders, starting with the beautiful tiger trainer, take center ring with Murdoch and Brackenreid.

episodes.title: Future Imperfect
episodes.summary: When Murdoch finds himself invited to a meeting of the local eugenics society, which is committed to research on genetic engineering, a dog shows up with a severed arm.

episodes.title: Love and Human Remains
episodes.summary: Two murdered but well-preserved bodies are found after a shed is torn down, and it's discovered that one of them had fought in the War of 1812.

episodes.title: The Curse of Beaton Manor
episodes.summary: Murdoch investigates the suicides of heirs to a great manor house and family fortune, but evidence begins to mount that it might be murder.

episodes.title: Hangman
episodes.summary: Detective Murdoch investigates a bizarre case when a convicted murderer apparently manages to survive the hangman's noose.

episodes.title: In the Altogether
episodes.summary: A model who poses for naughty postcard photos but moonlights as a prostitute is found strangled in the park. It is discovered that she was blackmailing her clients.

episodes.title: The Tesla Effect
episodes.summary: When Murdoch discovers that a victim has been cooked, he enlists the aid of Nicholas Tesla in tracking down a weaponized early version of a microwave.

episodes.title: Tattered and Torn
episodes.summary: Murdoch struggles to work with the new coroner and clashes openly when a cement block found near the water contains the remains of not one but three men.

episodes.title: Kommando
episodes.summary: Members of a squad of Canadian soldiers who recently were deployed to South Africa are stricken with a mysterious illness and others are being murdered.

episodes.title: Buffalo Shuffle
episodes.summary: Despite an unsolved break-in at the station house, Murdoch announces he's taking a vacation. His holiday turns out to be a trip in response to a telegram from Dr. Ogden requesting his help in Buffalo to solve what she thinks is a murder at The Children's Hospital. Murdoch agrees to go - thoughts of rekindling their relationship in the back of his mind. The case involves a 14-year-old terminally ill boy, Ben Wilkie, who has died under what Ogden feels are mysterious circumstances, not his cancer.

episodes.title: Downstairs, Upstairs
episodes.summary: Dark secrets surface at the Jenkins household when Murdoch questions the family and servants of murdered patriarch Percival Jenkins.

episodes.title: Monsieur Murdoch
episodes.summary: Murdoch investigates a case involving a young French woman who arrived in Toronto to visit her sister and then vanished without a trace. He is assisted by Detective Marcel Guillaume, recently arrived from Paris.Note: Guillaume is the real-life inspiration for author Georges Simenon's main character, Inspector Maigret.

episodes.title: Dead End Street
episodes.summary: While visiting a fair, Murdoch is fascinated by a perfect scale replica of a quiet Toronto street. His curiosity is further piqued when he discovers a model of a man holding a rifle inside one of the houses and proceeds to investigate a murder no one is sure actually happened.

episodes.title: Confederate Treasure
episodes.summary: A body found at a construction site leads Murdoch into the past and a conspiracy dating back to the American Civil War.

episodes.title: Dial M for Murdoch
episodes.summary: A telephone operator with ambitions to be a detective believes she's heard a woman strangled on an open line but Inspector Brackenreid is reluctant to believe her.

episodes.title: The Black Hand
episodes.summary: While investigating a lethal gunshot on a trolley that no one seems to have heard, Mudoch finds that the disappearance his old girlfriend Anna Fulford may be linked.

episodes.title: Voices
episodes.summary: When a convent tries to bury one of its most venerated members in the churchyard, another body is found in the plot. Murdoch is reunited with his sister.

episodes.title: Bloodlust
episodes.summary: The murder of a young student a an exclusive girls' school leads Murdoch to conclude that someone posing as a vampire is preying on several of the young girls.

episodes.title: The Kissing Bandit
episodes.summary: A Robin Hood-like bank robber with a flair for style kisses pretty female bank employees before donating the money he steals to a local orphanage.

episodes.title: Murdoch in Wonderland
episodes.summary: A man is found murdered at a Lewis Carroll-themed costume party. All clues point to the guest dressed as the Mad Hatter.

episodes.title: Murdoch of the Klondike
episodes.summary: On suspension for interfering in an investigation and on the run for surreptitiously freeing a murderer to make amends, Detective William Murdoch leaves Toronto for the Klondike Gold Rush, intent on a life beyond policing. While there he stumbles upon a murder investigation and soon realizes his days as a detective are not behind him.

episodes.title: Back and to the Left
episodes.summary: Detective Murdoch must tread carefully when he pursues a Catholic suspect in the murder of an Alderman, killed during the attempted assassination of the city's Protestant Mayor.

episodes.title: Evil Eye of Egypt
episodes.summary: When Detective Murdoch investigates a series of deaths linked to an exhibition of Egyptian antiquities, Constable Crabtree is convinced a mummy's curse is to blame.

episodes.title: War on Terror
episodes.summary: While investigating an explosion, Detective Murdoch infiltrates an anarchist group lead by American labour organizer Emma Goldman.

episodes.title: Murdoch at the Opera
episodes.summary: When Elvira Cummings, a young opera singer, is poisoned during a rehearsal of La bohème, Detective Murdoch suspects the intended victim was Madame Rosa Hamilton, the diva who stormed off stage moments before her protégé collapsed.

episodes.title: Who Killed the Electric Carriage?
episodes.summary: Detective Murdoch suspects the ambitious inventor of an electric vehicle murdered an associate who stood in the way of his plans to compete with Henry Ford.

episodes.title: Stroll on the Wild Side - Part One
episodes.summary: Detective Murdoch's investigation into the disappearance of a quiet librarian leads to a reunion with former love Anna Fulford and the discovery of a seamy underworld.

episodes.title: Stroll on the Wild Side - Part Two
episodes.summary: After saving his lover Anna from the Black Hand, Detective Murdoch bargains for her life. During his investigation into the murder of a shy librarian with a secret life, he encounters another young woman behaving seductively.

episodes.title: Invention Convention
episodes.summary: After a ruthless inventor is killed at a convention, Murdoch's investigation is assisted by his idol, Alexander Graham Bell.

episodes.title: Staircase to Heaven
episodes.summary: After a high stakes card game involving Dr. Grace ends with the death of a player, Murdoch is shocked to learn the true cost of their wagers is the opportunity to die.

episodes.title: Murdoch in Toyland
episodes.summary: Detective Murdoch is taunted by a deranged criminal who leaves talking dolls with macabre personal messages at each crime scene.

episodes.title: Murdoch Night in Canada
episodes.summary: Toronto's hockey championship fortunes rest on Murdoch's shoulders when he investigates the death of the team captain.

episodes.title: Twentieth Century Murdoch
episodes.summary: Murdoch investigates the claims of a man who says his time travels to the future provided him with information that allowed him to stop crimes, while the New Year's Eve Policeman's Ball offers exciting personal possibilities for the 20th century.

episodes.title: Murdoch Air
episodes.summary: When a flying machine crashes, killing a man on the ground, Murdoch's investigation uncovers high-level conspiracy and sabotage in the race to achieve the first human-controlled flight.

episodes.title: Winston's Lost Night
episodes.summary: After a veteran of a brutal North African battle is slain by a sword, Detective Murdoch's prime suspect is the victim's fellow soldier, who is none other than Winston Churchill.

episodes.title: Murdoch on the Corner
episodes.summary: After a series of seemingly random murders, Murdoch rigs a film camera with a timer on a downtown street corner in order to capture the killer.

episodes.title: A Study in Sherlock
episodes.summary: When Murdoch pursues a murderous gang of armed robbers, his prime suspect is a man claiming to be Sherlock Holmes.

episodes.title: Murdoch au Naturel
episodes.summary: Murdoch enlists some revealing detective work while investigating a murder at a nudist community.

episodes.title: Murdoch and the Cloud of Doom
episodes.summary: When an anonymous madman threatens the citizens of Toronto with a deadly toxic gas, Murdoch must race against the clock to stop him.

episodes.title: The Ghost of Queen's Park
episodes.summary: While investigating the death of a politician, rumoured to have been killed by a vengeful ghost, Crabtree's theories of the paranormal conflict with Murdoch's scientific beliefs.

episodes.title: Murdoch in Ladies Wear
episodes.summary: Murdoch investigates the murder of an Eaton's department store manager who was disliked by the shop girls.

episodes.title: Victoria Cross
episodes.summary: An uncooperative witness impedes Murdoch's investigation into a pawnbroker's murder, and Brackenreid faces resistance while looking into the prison death of an old army buddy.

episodes.title: Twisted Sisters
episodes.summary: A series of violent drowning deaths of university-educated unmarried career women leads Murdoch to suspect sexist and racist motives.

episodes.title: Lovers in a Murderous Time
episodes.summary: Detective Murdoch and Julia find themselves at odds when a delusional woman becomes the prime suspect in the violent stabbing of her gambling fiancé.

episodes.title: Crime and Punishment
episodes.summary: Detective Murdoch and his methods are compromised when one of his colleagues is implicated in a suspicious murder.

episodes.title: The Murdoch Trap
episodes.summary: With his colleague sentenced to hang for murder, Detective Murdoch races to exonerate them and steps into a trap set by the real killer.

episodes.title: Murdoch Ahoy
episodes.summary: Murdoch investigates the disappearance of a ship magnate's daughter and the discovery of a body aboard a ship on its inaugural Victoria Day voyage.

episodes.title: Tour de Murdoch
episodes.summary: When a competitor dies during a bicycle race, Murdoch suspects he was killed by large doses of a mysterious stimulant.

episodes.title: The Filmed Adventures of Detective William Murdoch
episodes.summary: After a man is shot in a movie house, Thomas Edison becomes a suspect and Murdoch is drawn into the behind-the-scenes drama of James Pendrick's filmmaking venture.

episodes.title: The Return of Sherlock
episodes.summary: Murdoch finds his investigation into a nanny's disappearance assisted by the man who considers himself the real Sherlock Holmes.

episodes.title: Murdoch of the Living Dead
episodes.summary: Murdoch's prime suspect in a woman's murder is her husband, who appears to have returned from the dead.

episodes.title: Murdochophobia
episodes.summary: Detective Murdoch investigates the death of one of Dr. Julia Ogden's phobia patients, but can Murdoch overcome his own phobia to solve the case?

episodes.title: Loch Ness Murdoch
episodes.summary: A summer heat wave finds much of Toronto taking refuge at the beach, but when a body marked by a large bite washes ashore, rumours of a sea monster quickly spread across the city.

episodes.title: Republic of Murdoch
episodes.summary: A dead body and a piece of parchment lead Murdoch and Crabtree to follow a suspect named Jacob Doyle to his home in Newfoundland.

episodes.title: A Midnight Train to Kingston
episodes.summary: Detective Murdoch accompanies convicted murderer James Gillies to his hanging.

episodes.title: Murdoch in Ragtime
episodes.summary: When the lead singer of a travelling ragtime group turns up dead, Detective Murdoch looks to the group's complicated past for answers.

episodes.title: Journey to the Centre of Toronto
episodes.summary: Murdoch investigates a rash of tunneling robberies that Crabtree is convinced were perpetrated by a species of mole people.

episodes.title: Unfinished Business
episodes.summary: After a dying man confesses a murder in what appears to be an open and shut case, Murdoch finds a body but suspects the real killer might still be alive.

episodes.title: The Murdoch Sting
episodes.summary: When a suspect from Murdoch's past pulls a deadly con, he orchestrates an elaborate sting so she won't get away with murder again.

episodes.title: Friday the 13th, 1901
episodes.summary: Julia and Emily attend a bachelorette party on a secluded, perhaps haunted island.

episodes.title: The Spy Who Came Up to the Cold
episodes.summary: The assassination of U.S. President McKinley in Buffalo prompts a roundup of Canada's anarchists, landing Murdoch in the middle of a web of international espionage and intrigue.

episodes.title: Kung Fu Crabtree
episodes.summary: When a Chinese dignitary visiting Toronto is poisoned, Crabtree teams up with the prime suspect – who he believes to be innocent – in order to track down the real killer.

episodes.title: Blast of Silence
episodes.summary: When an anti-progress zealot straps a bomb to a factory owner, Murdoch risks his own life to defuse it.

episodes.title: The Death of Dr. Ogden
episodes.summary: When Julia Ogden's father passes away, she uncovers an unexpected truth behind his death - and his life.

episodes.title: On the Waterfront - Part One
episodes.summary: Murdoch suspects the brutal murder of a waterfront merchant might be linked to the vicious assault on Inspector Brackenreid.

episodes.title: On the Waterfront - Part Two
episodes.summary: Murdoch and the constabulary confront more violence on the waterfront in their quest to bring Brackenreid's attackers to justice.

episodes.title: Glory Days
episodes.summary: Murdoch joins forces with legendary lawman Bat Masterson to hunt for Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid.

episodes.title: Holy Matrimony, Murdoch
episodes.summary: As their wedding day approaches, Murdoch and Ogden intervene in the trial of a woman accused of killing her husband.

episodes.title: Murdoch Takes Manhattan
episodes.summary: During their honeymoon in New York, Murdoch and Ogden uncover a deadly conspiracy threatening U.S. President Teddy Roosevelt.

episodes.title: The Murdoch Appreciation Society
episodes.summary: Murdoch discovers he's being followed by a group of detective admirers, while Ogden's work with the suffragette movement leads her to consider a run for political office.

episodes.title: What Lies Buried
episodes.summary: After the skeleton of a murdered police officer is found in the station house basement, Murdoch's investigation leads him to suspect his own colleagues.

episodes.title: High Voltage
episodes.summary: The electrocution of a man leads Murdoch back to inventor Thomas Edison.

episodes.title: The Keystone Constables
episodes.summary: When a vaudeville comedian is murdered, Crabtree and Higgins go undercover to investigate the other performers, including W.C. Fields.

episodes.title: Murdoch and the Temple of Death
episodes.summary: Murdoch and Crabtree explore a mysterious temple that may house ancient treasure - and deadly consequences for anyone who dares to hunt for it.

episodes.title: All That Glitters
episodes.summary: Murdoch and Crabtree follow the silver boom to Northern Ontario to investigate the murder of a land surveyor.

episodes.title: The Devil Wears Whalebone
episodes.summary: Murdoch discovers that fashion is murder when a model is killed during a protest at a designer corset show.

episodes.title: The Incurables
episodes.summary: Dr. Ogden's life is threatened by a group of deeply troubled and violent inmates at the asylum, including Eva Pearce, Mrs. Lynd and Rose Maxwell.

episodes.title: Toronto's Girl Problem
episodes.summary: Working with Brackenreid's nephew, Murdoch and the team discover a murdered woman may be connected to a gang of female jewel thieves.

episodes.title: Shipwreck
episodes.summary: Murdoch revisits his past when a murder investigation at a church reunites him with the priest who mentored him as a young altar boy.

episodes.title: CrabtreeMania
episodes.summary: Leading his first murder investigation, Crabtree uncovers deception and fraud when a wrestler dies after a match.

episodes.title: Election Day
episodes.summary: Dr. Ogden and the suffragettes face a setback on Election Day, while Murdoch investigates a murder with implications for national security.

episodes.title: Artful Detective
episodes.summary: While pursuing a sequential killer who collects macabre trophies from his victims, Murdoch becomes a target.

episodes.title: Nolo Contendere
episodes.summary: As Crabtree serves hard time for the murder of his sweetheart's abusive husband, Murdoch investigates the stabbing of an inmate who might be connected to the case.

episodes.title: Marked Twain
episodes.summary: When Mark Twain stirs up controversy during a speaking engagement in Toronto, Murdoch and his team must protect the esteemed American writer.

episodes.title: Double Life
episodes.summary: Murdoch and his colleagues investigate the murder of a young suffragette.

episodes.title: Barenaked Ladies
episodes.summary: The macabre discovery of statues made from the bodies of naked women leads Murdoch to suspect a sequential killer who knew the victims.

episodes.title: 24 Hours Til Doomsday
episodes.summary: Murdoch's investigation into a secret space program that could incite war between the U.S. and Canada leads him to an old friend.

episodes.title: The Local Option
episodes.summary: Murdoch investigates the poisoning of an anti-temperance politician.

episodes.title: Summer of '75
episodes.summary: When a childhood friend from wilderness camp alerts Murdoch to imminent danger, they travel to Algonquin Park to investigate a 30-year-old murder.

episodes.title: Pipe Dreamzzz
episodes.summary: After a student dies mysteriously in a professor's opium den, Crabtree helps Ogden and Rebecca James investigate in the morgue.

episodes.title: Raised on Robbery
episodes.summary: While at the bank for a loan on a special mother and baby promotion day, Murdoch finds himself in the midst of a bank heist that puts his reputation at risk.

episodes.title: The Big Chill
episodes.summary: Murdoch believes that an Arctic explorer is withholding information about a crew member's death.

episodes.title: A Case of the Yips
episodes.summary: During the investigation of the murder of a golfer, Murdoch becomes obsessed with the game.

episodes.title: Unlucky in Love
episodes.summary: Murdoch investigates the death of an groom; Crabtree meets Lucy Maud Montgomery at a writing class.

episodes.title: Colour Blinded
episodes.summary: The new chief inspector pressures Murdoch to make an arrest when a man is murdered in a church.

episodes.title: Wild Child
episodes.summary: Murdoch investigates a murder linked to a feral young woman.

episodes.title: House of Industry
episodes.summary: Murdoch goes under cover to investigate the murder of a reporter who was investigating a workhouse.

episodes.title: Bl**dy H*ll
episodes.summary: Murdoch and Brackenreid risk their careers to investigate police corruption.

episodes.title: From Buffalo with Love
episodes.summary: Murdoch and Brackenreid investigate a shooting in Buffalo.

episodes.title: Cometh the Archer
episodes.summary: The return of an adversary threatens the lives of Murdoch and Ogden.

episodes.title: Great Balls of Fire - Part One
episodes.summary: A debutante is murdered; Murdoch suspects rivals for a bachelor's affections.

episodes.title: Great Balls of Fire - Part Two
episodes.summary: A massive fire complicates a double homicide investigation.

episodes.title: A Study in Pink
episodes.summary: After Murdoch discovers his childhood friend turned private investigator Freddie Pink might be implicated in a murder, he enlists his latest invention to find the truth.

episodes.title: Concocting a Killer
episodes.summary: Murdoch and Ogden face the possibility that they sent an innocent man to prison after the reopening of a murder case.

episodes.title: Jagged Little Pill
episodes.summary: Murdoch and Ogden investigate the poisoning of a businessman; Rebecca James has suspicions about a fellow medical student's suicide.

episodes.title: Bend It Like Brackenreid
episodes.summary: While Murdoch investigates a football player's death, Brackenreid gets caught up in the team's Olympic quest.

episodes.title: Painted Ladies
episodes.summary: Murdoch suspects a connection between dead men found with lipstick smudges on their faces and Crabtree's burlesque dancer sweetheart.

episodes.title: Weekend at Murdoch's
episodes.summary: To catch a killer, Murdoch and Crabtree pretend a murdered witness is still alive.

episodes.title: Excitable Chap
episodes.summary: Murdoch strives to apprehend a lecherous costumed criminal known as The Lurker, whose amorous encounters have escalated to murder.

episodes.title: The Devil Inside
episodes.summary: Murdoch and Ogden contend with a killer who claims he's possessed by the devil.

episodes.title: A Murdog Mystery
episodes.summary: While investigating the death of a championship show dog, Murdoch discovers a hidden affection for canine companions.

episodes.title: The Missing
episodes.summary: Twenty years after a child was kidnapped, Murdoch investigates the identity of a man now claiming to be the wealthy heir.

episodes.title: Mr. Murdoch's Neighbourhood
episodes.summary: William and Julia study human decomposition and find more than they can imagine.

episodes.title: From Murdoch to Eternity
episodes.summary: Murdoch creates a tonic which restores youth but Crabtree worries about his pursuit of a partnership.

episodes.title: Hades Hath No Fury
episodes.summary: An explosion involving the mysterious woman Watts has been investigating leads Murdoch to a surreptitious community.

episodes.title: Master Lovecraft
episodes.summary: Murdoch investigates a group of death-obsessed teens after the discovery of a young girl's body.

episodes.title: Hot Wheels of Thunder
episodes.summary: Murdoch enters the world of competitive roller-skating to investigate a death.

episodes.title: Hell to Pay
episodes.summary: In the season finale, the team gets caught up in a conspiracy and is in danger when a dancer asks Murdoch for help.

episodes.title: Up from Ashes
episodes.summary: A jailed Murdoch must prove his innocence amid police and government corruption after the constables are ambushed, Ogden is kidnapped, and Brackenreid goes missing.

episodes.title: Merlot Mysteries
episodes.summary: Murdoch and Watts discover fraud after a wine connoisseur is poisoned.

episodes.title: 8 Footsteps
episodes.summary: A recording device made by Alexander Graham Bell assists in the investigation of a murder at a dinner honoring Helen Keller.

episodes.title: The Canadian Patient
episodes.summary: Murdoch investigates a surgeon performing cutting-edge organ transplants.

episodes.title: Dr. Osler Regrets
episodes.summary: Murdoch suspects that a sequential killer is behind a number of murders staged to look like suicides.

episodes.title: 21 Murdoch Street
episodes.summary: In an attempt to solve a murder, Crabtree and Constable Brackenreid go under cover at a boys school.

episodes.title: The Accident
episodes.summary: Murdoch investigates a car accident and uncovers sinister motives.
